Located in the First Responder Network Authority (FirstNet Authority)’s Boulder, Colorado facility, the PSITC provides opportunities to conduct immersive public safety standards and measurements testing. The facility is designed to help answer key research questions around the future of user experience and location-based services for public safety training and operations. The ACS PUMS files are a set of records from individual people or housing units, with disclosure protection enabled so that individuals or housing units cannot be identified. The Census Bureau produces ACS 1-year and 5-year PUMS files. These files are accessible using the microdata access tool on data.census.gov and the Census Bureau's FTP site .* Only selected geographic areas are identified in the ACS PUMS, including nation, regions, divisions, states, and Public Use Microdata Areas (PUMAs) . May 15, 2024 Español Put the Brakes on Diabetes Complications What to know People with diabetes are living longer with fewer complications. Greater awareness and better management of risk factors is helping. Find out what you can do to prevent or delay diabetes health problems. Diabetes complications are decreasing We've come a long way in reducing the impact of diabetes on people's lives. In the last 20 years, rates of several major complications have decreased among U.S. adults with diabetes. The greatest declines were for two leading causes of death: heart attack and stroke. This is real progress. People with diabetes are at higher risk for heart disease. They may also get it more severely and at a younger age than people who don't have diabetes. Diabetes complications are related Diabetes complications often share the same risk factors, and one complication can make other complications worse. For example, many people with diabetes also have high blood pressure, which in turn worsens eye and kidney diseases. But with 25 Canadians plying their trade on English soil in Premiership Women's Rugby (PWR) last season, their success on the international stage comes at a time when PWR has been in discussions with the Rugby Football Union (RFU) to review the numbers of overseas players in the league. "We are keen to attract star talent into PWR to continue to make it the best league in the world," said RFU chief executive Bill Sweeney. "But we've also got to protect England Red Roses' interests as well." Quantum Information Science Quantum mechanics describes how the smallest particles in nature behave and interact. It describes how matter and light interact at the atomic and subatomic level. Quantum information science uses novel principles from quantum mechanics to transform computing, sensing, and communication as we know them. Quantum Research and Development Quantum mechanics and information sciences have been key to many technological advances in the 20th century. They have led to astonishing progress in computing, sensing, and networking. The unusual effects predicted by quantum mechanics may enable similarly transformative applications in the future. One such application is quantum computing. Quantum computers are fundamentally different from their classical counterparts and are expected to be drastically better at performing certain types of calculations than today’s most powerful computers. They could greatly improve our ability to solve currently intractable problems. Scientists anticipate that quantum computers will be able to accelerate discovery by simulating quantum systems. These systems include molecules used as catalysts in chemical processes, elusive particles inside the nuclei of atoms, and complex materials.

So the first thing I asked him was, "What are you doing?" He looked up at me, holding a tiny metal cross charm on a hoop, and laughed. "I'm just trying things lately," he said. Turns out, at that moment, he was trying out belt charms. But that also sums up the new Queens of the Stone Age album, Perfecth , which finds the band branching out in new musical directions. Emma Bond, currently Assistant Chief Constable at Police Scotland, was named in May as the preferred choice to replace Alex Franklin-Smith following his retirement in April. But more than four months later, the PCC announced that Bond's preferred candidate status had been withdrawn, meaning she will no longer take up the role. In a statement, Warwickshire PCC Philip Seccombe said no further comment would be made. However, the decision to effectively withdraw the job offer, which was subject to vetting, raises questions about the leadership of the county force. It comes after David Gardner, the current Acting Chief Constable, has already been appointed as the new head of Staffordshire Police, following a four week recruitment process. The PCC said arrangements would be announced to "to ensure continuity of leadership for Warwickshire Police", but gave no timetable. Activity measurements for γ-ray-emitting radionuclides are made using 4πγ ionization chambers calibrated against primary standards developed in the Radioactivity Group. Primary standards of α- and β-emitting radionuclides are typically developed using 4πβ liquid scintillation spectrometry and 4πβ-γ anticoincidence counting. The calibration process also includes the identification and quantification of radionuclidic impurities by high-purity germanium γ-ray spectrometry. Recent development work has focused on therapeutic nuclides for nuclear medicine, radioimmunotherapy, bone palliation, and diagnostic imaging. The current focus of our work is on the development of standards and measurement tools for α-emitters used in Targeted Alpha Therapy and in the development of quantitative tools for preclinical imaging. pages.description: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.
pages.text: Rafael Nadal: Tennis legend set to join Real Madrid board of directors - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Rafael Nadal has made a number of appearances on the pitch at Real Madrid matches By Mike Peter BBC Sport Journalist Published 4 November 2026 Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid. Nadal won 22 Grand Slam titles, two Olympic gold medals and helped Spain claim five Davis Cups before retiring in 2024 . Real's members will be asked to approve the 40-year-old's appointment to the board at a meeting later this month. In a statement announcing the move , external , the club said Nadal was "one of the greatest legends in the history of sport and one of the most admired and recognised Spanish athletes in the world". "It is a great source of pride that a figure of his sporting and human stature, a benchmark of Spanish and world sport, will become part of our board of directors and contribute, from this position of responsibility, to the present and future of our club," Real added. The tennis legend - a boyhood Real fan who holds member's number 67,778 - included a photo of himself as a child in a club kit in his response to the news. "I want to thank president Florentino Perez and the board for proposing that I join the board of directors of Real Madrid," Nadal said in his post on X , external . "I have accepted this proposal with great excitement, a desire to learn, and a willingness to contribute everything I can." pages.text: Rail Engineering Works Explained | National Rail Skip to main content Engineering Works Explained There are more than 20,000 miles of track, 45,000 bridges and tunnels, and 6,500 level crossings in the network, not to mention power cables, signalling equipment and more. To keep the railway running smoothly, sometimes we need to check, maintain, repair or replace things Advertisement Bridge and tunnel maintenance There are around 45,000 bridges and tunnels across the railway network. Each of these require inspection and maintenance on a regular basis to ensure that trains can run reliably and safely throughout the year. The work can include, but is not limited to, replacement of tunnel linings, drainage, bridge beams and structures. Level crossing maintenance There are over 6,500 level crossings across the railway network, where footpaths/roads and railway lines cross. It is important that level crossings operate safely to allow pedestrians and other road users to cross the railway line safely. It is necessary to carry out maintenance of the level crossings to ensure that they continue to work safely for all users of the crossing. Lineside equipment renewal Lineside equipment relates to items such as points heaters, axle counters and train describers that do not form part of the signalling system. However, they are vital to the safe operation of the railway and if not maintained can lead to delays.
